item.description: The Porsche Club of America’s 10th annual Werks Reunion Amelia Island presented by Pirelli met all the hallmarks of an epic event. Perfect temperatures, no precipitation, and a record turnout of Porsches. Enthusiasts and even moderate Porsche fans were seen smiling throughout the day.

Enter the Spring 2026 Member Only Raffle — Win a 70th Anniversary Club Coupe! | Porsche Club of America
item.description: Each fall and spring, PCA holds a raffle, in which you, the member, may purchase entries for a chance to win a brand-new Porsche. For the Spring 2026 Member Only Raffle, the first grand prize is a PCA 70th Anniversary 911 Club Coupe plus a $60,000 cash prize. Subsequent grand prizes are a 2026 911 Carrera plus a $40,000 cash prize. All entries received by June 1, 2026, will be accepted into the raffle. Remember: More entries equal more grand prizes.

item.title: Shattering Records: The Top 10 Porsche Sales at Amelia Island 2026 | Porsche Club of America
item.description: Although only two major auction houses anchored Amelia Island Car Week this year, Porsche’s presence was felt everywhere. Both Gooding Christie’s and Broad Arrow Auctions showcased a masterclass in diversity from the Stuttgart marque. Arguably, the shock of the week was the PTS Gulf Blue Carrera GT, which crushed many attendees’ expectations with its final hammer price.

item.title: Porsche-Penske victorious at 2026 Sebring 12 after team-order drama | Porsche Club of America
item.description: The 74th running of the Mobil 1 Twelve Hours of Sebring turned into a numbers game. As in a number of historic milestones achieved for Porsche as a brand and Porsche Penske Motorsports as an organization. Porsche achieved a 1-2 finish in two classes for the first time since 2008. It was the 17th time Porsche finished 1-2 overall at the Twelve Hours of Sebring, extending its record for overall wins to 20.

item.title: Pirelli P Zero Development: OEM Compounds, Data, & Engineering Explained | Tech Tactics | Porsche Club of America
item.description: Davide Conti, Research & Development Director for Pirelli North America, was a guest presenter at the 2026 Tech Tactics East event. He discusses the development of the P Zero tire and does a deep dive into the various compounds they use for different OEMs. He also talks about how Pirelli works with car manufacturers to extract data from our customers use their tires. It’s a fascinating look behind the scenes of how tires are made.

item.title: Protect Your Investment: Navigating Diminished Value Claims with Super Car Claims | Tech Tactics Live | Porsche Club of America
item.description: Steven Calamusa, PCA member and Super Car Claims founder, will be on Tech Tactics Live Wednesday, March 25, at 8 PM ET to answer all your questions about diminished value claims. This will be a popular episode since it covers not only Porsches but any of your cars that qualify. You’ll hear about real life examples of what happens when things to wrong and how to be reimbursed to the fullest.
